components.name: In-page tab strip: Datos Personales / Dependientes / Direccion (+ hidden Tarjetas Registradas)

components.action: Loads disabled, preset to 'Republica Dominicana' — effectively fixed/read-only for this account.

components.name: Provincia (#cpBody_cbProvincia) [Direccion]
components.action: Loads disabled. Same province list as elsewhere in the app (Azua, Barahona, Dajabon, Distrito Nacional, ...).

components.name: Agregar Direccion (#cpBody_bDireccion) [Direccion]
components.action: input[type=submit], no visible text — would create a real saved address. Not submitted.

components.name: Direcciones grid (#cpBody_gvDireccion) [Direccion]
components.action: DevExpress grid, columns: Editar, Borrar, Direccion, Nota, Principal. Currently empty for this test account.

components.name: 'No data to display' [Direccion grid]
components.action: DevExpress empty-state row (#cpBody_gvDireccion_DXEmptyRow).

notes: Per Phase 1's sitemap.json, the visible tab list is Datos Personales / Dependientes / Direccion; a 4th tab, 'Tarjetas Registradas' (#cpBody_lefticontab3), exists in the DOM but is hidden and not reachable.

Multiple disabled selects (Sucursal on Datos Personales tab; Pais and Provincia on Direccion tab) suggest fields the account cannot currently self-edit — worth flagging for the redesign: unclear to the user WHY these are locked (no visible explanation/tooltip).

UX/accessibility issue carried from Phase 1: the Provincia/Ciudad/Sector dropdowns on the Direccion tab render as solid-color boxes with truncated/invisible label text (see screenshot mi-cuenta-direccion.png).
None of the three forms (Datos Personales save, Dependientes add, Direccion add) were submitted — each would write real, persisted account data.
